critique: The note proves an exact ATE identified interval for its maintained common-binary-confounder class, including interior endpoint attainment, a one-arc optimization reduction, and a certified strict gap from its own separate-pair relaxation. Its significance is limited by the absence of any proved translation to an established sensitivity model: the numerical tightening is against an internally constructed relaxation, so it does not establish improvement over a procedure practitioners currently use. The semialgebraic certificate and atlas are mathematical termination results rather than a reproducible implementation with demonstrated computational behavior, which weakens the applied case. The advertised inference contribution is only pointwise on a unique smooth active branch; uniform inference at the branch switches and degeneracies emphasized by the tipping atlas remains open, precluding a stronger frontier claim.
